scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Take a look at this.
According to the design drawing, this part is connected to the central room... But I only see a suspicious gate.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
请看一下这个。
根据设计图，这部分是连接中枢室的……但我只看到一扇可疑的门。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
No wonder it looked like they had something to back them up.
Shall we use an explosive and blow it up?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
难怪看起来他们有什么后援。
我们要用炸药把它炸开吗？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Not in such a crude way!
Well, I made a great decision when I came here.
Tell him to open this.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
不能这么粗暴！
好吧，我当初决定来这里真是个英明的决定。
告诉他打开这扇门。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I asked him whether he knows the paths here, and his answer was yes. So I brought him here.
He will activate the gate to the central room.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
我问他是否熟悉这里的路，他说是的。所以我带他来了。
他会启动通往中枢室的门。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hmm, I see. That's the way to operate it.
Great, now I got it.
And we don't need him anymore.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯，明白了。这就是操作方法。
太好了，我现在懂了。
而且我们也不需要他了。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Really? Then I will bring this researcher to the squadron outside.
About the central room, {0} I am counting on you!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
真的吗？那我会带这位研究员去外面的中队。
中枢室的事，就拜托你了，{0}！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Haha, they let us open the gate of the central room!
Please speak to me again once you are ready to go in here.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哈哈，他们让我们打开中枢室的门！
准备好进去的时候，请再跟我对话。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
After activating the gate, we have to guard it from outside.
So I cannot go in there with you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
启动门之后，我们必须在外面守卫。
所以我不能和你一起进去。

scripts.text:
^4d4dffThis event is proceeded to the Memorial.
Please try again after organizing a party.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff此活动已推进至纪念阶段。
请在组建队伍后重试。^000000

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Are you ready?
If you are entering now, I will activate the gate.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你准备好了吗？
如果你现在要进去，我就启动门。

scripts.text: Enter now.
scripts.translation: 现在进入

scripts.text: Do not enter.
scripts.translation: 不要进入

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We both know that we don't have time for this, don't we?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我们都知道，我们没有时间做这些，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Wow! This is it! I always learn things quickly!
Well, please go in now!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哇！就是这个！我学东西总是很快！
好了，请进去吧！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Have you reclaimed the stuff?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你拿回东西了吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We have found a strange phenomenon in the central room. We are not investigating it.
Perhaps there was a strong experimental subject left inside.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我们在中枢室发现了一种奇怪的现象。我们并没有在调查它。
也许里面留下了一个强大的实验体。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What kind of facility is this?
Ssss.
Once it is identified appropriately, I might ask you for a settlement ...
I will have to guard the gate of the central room again.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
这是什么设施？
嘶嘶。
一旦确认清楚，我可能会向你要求结算……
我又得去守卫中枢室的门了。

scripts.text:
^4d4dffThis event is proceeded to the Memorial.
Please try again after organizing a party.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff此活动已推进至纪念阶段。
请在组建队伍后重试。^000000

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If there is a gate that has already been activated, you can see it.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
如果有一扇已经启动的门，你可以看到它。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Otherwise, please ask your party leader for entrance.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
否则，请让你的队伍首领请求进入。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Are you ready?
If you are entering now, I will activate the gate.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你准备好了吗？
如果你现在要进去，我就启动门。

scripts.text: Enter now.
scripts.translation: 现在进入

scripts.text: Do not enter.
scripts.translation: 不要进入

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We both know that we don't have time for this, don't we?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我们都知道，我们没有时间做这些，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Wow! This is it! I always learn things quickly!
Well, please go in now!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哇！就是这个！我学东西总是很快！
好了，请进去吧！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We are not sure how many more experimental subjects are there that were made and abandoned by that Eisen Werner guy.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我们不确定那个艾森·维尔纳的家伙还制造并遗弃了多少实验体。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
But let's call it a day.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
但今天就到此为止吧。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffMD Only the party leader can enter [Central room] now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dffMD 目前只有队伍首领可以进入[中枢室]。^000000

scripts.text: You can move to the central room.
scripts.translation: 您可以前往中枢室。

scripts.text: Go in.
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text: Do not go in.
scripts.translation: 不进去

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh ... I have to turn it on every time. It's so inconvenient!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
噢...每次都得手动开启，真是不方便！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The gate is malfunctioning now. It's dangerous like this ...
Please wait for a while.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
大门现在出了故障，这样很危险...
请稍等片刻。

scripts.text: An unknown error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生未知错误。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Experiment_number: {1}

[Eisen Werner]
Here comes the main character.
Honestly, I'm impressed. I never expected you would come all the way here.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
主角终于登场了。
说实话，我很惊讶。没想到你会一路走到这里。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Well, whatever.
Welcome.
Welcome to Eisen Werner's world.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
好吧，不管怎样。
欢迎。
欢迎来到艾森·维尔纳的世界。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
I never imagined that it would be done all of a sudden like this.
Whatever. Who cares?
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
我从未想过事情会突然变成这样。
算了，谁在乎呢？

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
I've given up saving this laboratory anyway.
Would you like to take a look?
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
反正我已经放弃拯救这个实验室了。
你想看看吗？

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
There were many things, including cracks in dimensions, etc.
In some worlds, the flow of time is twisted.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
这里有很多东西，包括维度裂缝等。
在某些世界里，时间的流动是扭曲的。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Is it a parallel world?
Or has someone been to a certain point in the past?
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
这是平行世界吗？
还是说有人回到了过去的某个时间点？

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
What does time mean? Have you ever thought about it?
Its flow is relative.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
时间意味着什么？你思考过吗？
它的流动是相对的。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
That guy has stopped now.
If time goes biologically, it means someone gets older.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
那个人现在停止了。
如果时间按生物规律流逝，那就意味着有人变老了。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
That was stopped by force.
In that case, we use an expression such as this.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
那是被强行停止的。
在这种情况下，我们会使用这样的表达。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
The time has stopped.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
时间停止了。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
....
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
...

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Would you like to take a look inside?
Take your time and look through the corridor.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
你想进去看看吗？
慢慢走，穿过走廊看看。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
I will guide you.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
我会为你指引方向。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Did you enjoy my work?
I sent the silly guys back to start over.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
你喜欢我的作品吗？
我把那些愚蠢的家伙送回去重新开始了。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Well, it wasn't easy at all.
......
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
嗯，这并不容易。
...

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
If only that kid had gone back, he would not have ended that way...
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
如果那个小孩当时回去了，就不会落得那样的下场了...

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
I mean, if only he stopped...
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
我是说，如果他能停下来就好了...

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
The chairman... I mean, that person is obsessed with the past.
Thanks to the chairman, I can do my research as I want.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
会长...我是说，那个人对过去非常执着。
多亏了会长，我才能随心所欲地进行研究。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Aren't you curious about it?
Why is he so obsessed with the past?
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
你不觉得好奇吗？
他为什么对过去如此执着？

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
By the way, you have to operate the instruments on the right and left if you want to go beyond this.... Can you do it?
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
顺便说一下，如果你想越过这里，必须操作左右两边的仪器。你能做到吗？

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Since it's a simple device, I guess you can.
Change ^ff0000red^000000 to ^4d4dffblue^000000.
And change ^4d4dffblue^000000 to ^ff0000red^000000. That's it.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
既然只是简单的装置，我想你应该没问题。
把^ff0000红色^000000变成^4d4dff蓝色^000000。
再把^4d4dff蓝色^000000变成^ff0000红色^000000。就这样。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
If you looked at my work properly, you'll understand what I am saying.
Then I'll see you in the next zone.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
如果你仔细看过我的作品，就会明白我在说什么。
那我在下一个区域等你。

scripts.text: It is already activated.
scripts.translation: 它已经启动了。

scripts.text:
There are security codes written down.
[{0}]
What will you input?
scripts.translation:
上面写着安全代码。
[{0}]
你要输入什么？

scripts.text: The device has been initialized.
scripts.translation: 装置已初始化。

scripts.text:
Operated the security device.
Seems like there is one more security device.
scripts.translation:
操作了安全装置。
看来还有一个安全装置。

scripts.text:
Operated the security device.
The gate is now activated.
scripts.translation:
操作了安全装置。
大门已启动。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Easier than you thought?
The next security devices are similar, so I won't have to explain again.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
比你想象的简单吧？
接下来的安全装置也差不多，我就不多解释了。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
After looking around here, what do you think?
Isn't it amazing?
Have you been to ^4d4dffVerus^000000?
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
在这里转了一圈之后，你觉得怎么样？
是不是很惊人？
你去过^4d4dff维鲁斯^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
That is the laboratory I built by referring to it.
It was my type.
......
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
那是我参考它建造的实验室。
很合我的口味。
......

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
The technology was completely different from what we'd had until then.
We've used everything available.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
那里的技术与我们之前拥有的完全不同。
我们利用了一切可用的资源。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
What do you say?
Does it look good?
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
你觉得呢？
看起来不错吧？

scripts.text: Do you wonder why I'm saying these things?
scripts.translation: 你想知道我为什么这么说吗？

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Hmm, that's because you're going to die here anyway.
So I would like to promote my achievements.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
嗯，那是因为反正你都要死在这里了。
所以我想宣传一下我的成就。

scripts.text: Die here? Me?
scripts.translation: 死在这里？我？

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Certainly. You'll die here.
Do you think I am just stupid enough to be left here alone?
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
当然。你会死在这里。
你以为我会蠢到独自留在这里吗？

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
I know you've come here for the affair of Rune-Midgarts kingdom.
So I've prepared something.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
我知道你是为了卢恩·米德加兹王国的事务而来的。
所以我准备了一些东西。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
With a huge sensation.
You shall die. Right here.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
伴随着巨大的震撼。
你将会死去。就在这里。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Therefore, just be my guest.
Let's move to the next zone.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
因此，请随意。
让我们进入下一个区域吧。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Beyond this wall, there will be something you have come to obtain.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
在这堵墙的另一边，会有你前来获取的东西。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Right. That thing you carved into a gem and used as a decoration on the crown.
Do you even know what it is?
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
没错。就是那个被雕刻成宝石并用作王冠装饰的东西。
你知道那是什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Although it is a scrap, it's the heart fragment of Ymir.
It cannot be compared to an imitation.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
虽然只是一块碎片，但它是尤弥尔的心脏碎片。
它无法与仿制品相提并论。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
... The fools in the kingdom cannot even utilize the power they already have.
What a pity.
So I decided to use it...
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
... 王国里的傻瓜们甚至无法利用他们已有的力量。
真是可惜。
所以我决定使用它...

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
You want to reclaim it? It's all up to your capability.
I haven't been waiting with empty hands.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
你想夺回它吗？这完全取决于你的能力。
我可没有空手等待。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Let me tell you once again. Don't be surprised.
No, I'd be glad if you were surprised.
Huhuhuhuhu....
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
让我再告诉你一次。别惊讶。
不，如果你惊讶了我会很高兴。
呼呼呼呼...

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Now, take a look at the gift I've prepared.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
现在，看看我准备的礼物吧。

scripts.text: Replaying the story.
scripts.translation: 重播剧情。

scripts.text:
You have two choices in the next zone.
If you want to replay the story of Seyren Windsor, please select ^4d4dffProceed with the story^000000. If you want to see the masterpiece of Eisen Werner, please select ^4d4dffProceed with the battle^000000.
scripts.translation:
在下一个区域你有两个选择。
如果你想重播塞伦·温莎的剧情，请选择^4d4dff继续剧情^000000。如果你想看艾森·维尔纳的杰作，请选择^4d4dff继续战斗^000000。

scripts.text: Proceed with the story.
scripts.translation: 继续剧情

scripts.text: Proceed with the battle.
scripts.translation: 继续战斗

scripts.text: You've selected the story.
scripts.translation: 你选择了剧情。

scripts.text: You've selected the battle.
scripts.translation: 你选择了战斗。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffOnly the party leader can proceed with this event.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff只有队伍首领才能继续此活动。^000000

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with quest because you have too many items in your possession. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您持有的物品过多，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
This place is the core of the laboratory, and contains everything of my research.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
这里是实验室的核心，包含了我所有的研究成果。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
It is the heart fragment of Ymir that holds the fundamental power to constitute the world. It also holds the origin of life.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
这是尤弥尔的心脏碎片，蕴含着构成世界的基本力量，也是生命的起源。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Look at this carefully.
What you've come to reclaim is doing something marvelous!
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
仔细看看这个。
你们前来夺回的东西，正在做着不可思议的事情！

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
The energy extracted from this flows into the magic circle on the ground... Ha ha ha. Of course, this magic circle has been reinterpreted magically.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
从这里提取出的能量流入地面的魔法阵中……哈哈哈哈哈。当然，这个魔法阵已经被我重新解读过了。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
In any case, the energy goes into the experimental subject... Using that power, I've adjusted their time.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
总之，能量流入了实验体中……利用那股力量，我调整了它们的时间。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
... Certainly, some of them get killed due to chapped cells. Ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
……确实，有些实验体因为细胞破裂而死亡了。哈哈！

scripts.text: Is that all you want to say?
scripts.translation: 这就是你想说的全部吗？

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
No! Never!
Have you already forgotten what I told you earlier?
I told you I'd prepared a gift.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
不！绝不！
难道你已经忘了我之前告诉你的话吗？
我说过我准备了一份礼物。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Something...
that will surprise you.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
一份……
会让你们感到惊讶的礼物。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
How do you like the gift I've prepared?!
Are you satisfied?
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
你们喜欢我准备的这份礼物吗？！
满意吗？

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
This fellow was among the delegation of that silly royal family.
Thanks to the experiment of some brave guy, I have obtained this great stuff.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
这家伙是那个愚蠢王室代表团中的一员。
多亏了某个勇敢家伙的实验，我获得了这件伟大的东西。

scripts.text: Are you talking about the In Vivo Experiment?
scripts.translation: 你是在说体内实验吗？

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Yeah, exactly.
Well, there are plenty guys who do In Vivo Experiments apart from that fellow, but he was the first one brave enough to enhance a living creature.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
没错，正是如此。
嗯，除了这家伙之外，还有很多人在进行体内实验，但他是第一个勇敢到对生物进行强化的。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
using the imitated heart fragment of Ymir
It was a great turning point for the In Vivo Experiments.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
利用仿制的尤弥尔心脏碎片。
这对体内实验来说是一个巨大的转折点。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
I was trying to apply it to many kinds of stuff.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
我正试图将其应用于许多其他事物上。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
By the way....
You should say hello to it. Right?
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
顺便说一句……
你应该跟它打个招呼，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Ah~. That's right.
You don't need to say hello, because both of you are going to die!
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
啊~。没错。
你们不需要打招呼，因为你们两个都要死了！

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Seyren, escort these guests to hell.
Do you understand what I am saying?
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
塞伦，把这些客人送到地狱去。
你明白我的意思吗？

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
.......

[Eisen Werner]
Hmm?
What is this, Seyren? Is it a negative phase now?
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
嗯？
塞伦，这是怎么回事？现在进入负面阶段了吗？

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
I feel like I've woken up from a long sleep.
Maybe it was for this day.
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
我感觉自己像是从漫长的沉睡中醒来。
也许，就是为了这一天。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Do not forget your duty, Seyren.
You are a weapon. You are nothing more than a puppet with the outfit of a knight called Seyren Windsor.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
别忘了你的职责，塞伦。
你只是一件武器。你不过是一个穿着“塞伦·温莎”骑士装束的傀儡。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Do you need me to explain step by step?
After transplanting the dummy of Ymir's Heart, the body could not endure the power and eventually collapsed.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
需要我一步步解释吗？
在移植了“尤弥尔之心”的复制体后，身体无法承受那股力量，最终崩溃了。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Then its spirit duplicated the main body and kept dividing over and over.
During that process, its memory, consciousness, soul, mind and ego were all scattered like sand. They became meaningless.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
随后，它的灵魂复制了本体，并不断分裂。
在这个过程中，它的记忆、意识、灵魂、心智和自我都如沙粒般散落。它们变得毫无意义。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
When we transplanted the dummy of Ymir's Heart into someone with a strong mind and body, we expected that person would become a stronger biological weapon.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
当我们把“尤弥尔之心”的复制体移植到身心强大的人身上时，我们预期那个人会成为更强大的生物武器。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
We never expected that it would duplicate itself and divide endlessly. As a result, that experiment was regarded as a failure.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
我们从未预料到它会自我复制并无限分裂。结果，那次实验被视为失败。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
To make things worse, it was an uncontrollable creature that was filled only with fury.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
更糟糕的是，那变成了一个只充满愤怒、无法控制的怪物。

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
I am here.
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
我在这里。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
You know what? They are still dividing now.
Just imitating the main body, they are even growing inside it.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
你知道吗？它们现在还在分裂。
它们只是模仿本体，甚至在其内部生长。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Since they are imperfect beings now, they want to become perfect.
They are imperfect beings now, so they want to become perfect, rather than just imitating the main body and living as a virtual image.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
既然它们现在是不完美的存在，它们就想要变得完美。
它们不想仅仅模仿本体，像虚拟影像一样活着，而是想要成为完美的存在。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
They wish to exist as a singular entity.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
它们渴望作为单一实体而存在。

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
And the only successful experiment is you. We call you Seyren now.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
而唯一成功的实验就是你。我们现在称你为塞伦。

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
...... Is it the end of your will?
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
...... 你的意志到此为止了吗？

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Hey, baby? You can't do this to me.
You must obey me!
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
嘿，小家伙？你不能这样对我。
你必须服从我！

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Don't you remember how much I struggled to bring you here out of that hell?
Do not be swayed by the consciousness of someone who's already dead.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
你不记得我费了多大劲才把你从那个地狱里带出来吗？
不要被那个已经死去的人的意识所动摇。

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
... Eisen Werner.
Let me ask you again. Is it the end of your will?
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
... 艾森·维尔纳。
让我再问你一次。你的意志到此为止了吗？

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Damn!
I never expected this!
Isn't this world a funny place? Ha ha ha ha ha
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
该死！
我从未预料到这一点！
这个世界真是个有趣的地方，哈哈哈哈哈

scripts.text:
[Eisen Werner]
Never think that I'm finished here.
I don't need a loser either.
scripts.translation:
[艾森·维尔纳]
别以为我这就结束了。
我也不需要失败者。

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
... Eisen. You have abandoned everything like this.
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
... 艾森。你就像这样抛弃了一切。

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
.. Ah...

[Seyren]
The solidity is weakening again.
Now, I have a much more urgent message for you rather than for Eisen.
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
实体正在再次变得虚弱。
比起艾森，我现在有一件更紧急的事要告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
I've been waiting for you for a long time.
As Eisen said, it's no longer important whether I'm Seyren or not.
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
我等了你好久。
正如艾森所说，我是不是塞伦已经不再重要了。

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
Since I had the ability to think, I didn't know who I was nor why I existed.
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
自从拥有思考能力以来，我就不知道自己是谁，也不知道为何存在。

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
The continuous division created countless copies of myself.
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
不断的分裂创造出了无数我的复制体。

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
The power entwined with the dummy of Ymir's Heart, which responded to my will and that of my companions. They wanted to unite, but kept dividing themselves over and over.
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
那股力量与尤弥尔之心的傀儡交织在一起，回应着我以及同伴们的意志。它们渴望结合，却一次又一次地分裂。

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
How many copies of myself have been created so far?
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
到目前为止，究竟创造出了多少个我的复制体？

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
I lost the ego after continuous division, but was regenerated as the previous shape. I don't think it was a coincidence.
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
在不断的分裂中我失去了自我，却又以之前的形态再生。我认为这绝非巧合。

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
I thought there must have been a reason.
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
我想其中一定有其缘由。

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
And I realized it after looking at ^4d4dffTerra Gloria^000000.
The reason why the god gave me this opportunity.
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
在凝视^4d4dff泰拉·格洛丽亚^000000之后，我意识到了这一点。
这就是神赐予我这个机会的原因。

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
Have you come to reclaim this?
... The land is gone and only the star remains.
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
你是来收回这个的吗？
...大地已经消失，只剩下星辰。

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
Eisen is right. ^4d4dffSeyren Windsor is no longer in this world.^000000
All I have now is the strong will to transfer something on and on.
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
艾森说得对。^4d4dff暗●卢恩骑士已不在这个世界了。^000000
我现在拥有的，只有想要不断传递某物的强烈意志。

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
Maybe that bit of will made me exist.
But it's over now.
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
也许正是那一缕意志让我得以存在。
但现在，一切都结束了。

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
.....

[Seyren]
I really don't have more time.
After this moment, ^4d4dffI will be divided and scattered.^000000 again.
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
我真的没时间了。
这一刻之后，^4d4dff我将再次分裂并消散。^000000

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
While I still have my will now, I have one message to give you.
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
趁我现在还保有意志，有一句话要留给你。

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
Please, go ahead.
Seyren Windsor, the knight of Prontera failed in the task.
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
请继续前行吧。
普隆德拉的骑士塞伦·温莎，未能完成任务。

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
^4d4dffMe and all my companions died long ago.
Please don't waste your affections on the bodies that are already dead.^000000
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
^4d4dff我和所有同伴早已死去。
请不要将情感寄托在已经死去的躯壳上。^000000

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
They are just like ghosts covered with peels.
I was lucky to show my last will in front of you.
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
它们就像披着皮的幽灵。
能向你展示我最后的遗愿，是我的幸运。

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
They are ^4d4dffrelics^000000 of me and my companions.
Please give them to our families.
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
它们是我与同伴们的^4d4dff遗物^000000。
请把它们交给我们的家人。

scripts.text:
[Seyren]
It was great to see you at the end.
Thank you... Bye.
scripts.translation:
[塞伦]
最后能见到你，真好。
谢谢...再见。
